name: core-search
description: Search, the core's full-text search: the index kept in the transaction of each create, update, delete and operation that changes an indexed field, ranking by the weights, paging, plain words and the opt-in FTS5 syntax, answers only for a caller who may read the schema and only from the caller's namespace, the config's rules, and the index rebuilt or dropped when a version changes the fields or adds or removes Search.
